### workspace lib
--- exit 0
--- stdout
play   binding              builtin  How to work in a pane that workspace has bound to a run, a review or a play
play   commits              builtin  Cohesive commits, tests and lint first, no attribution, no push
play   dev                  builtin  Queue for the project's shared dev environment before you implement, test or verify, and give it up when you are done
play   handoff              builtin  Check context after every task and hand off to a fresh conversation before it runs out
play   implementation-plan  builtin  Keep a counted task list in the workspace's IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md so progress shows in workspace and any session can resume
play   notes                builtin  Read and write this workspace's working notes in its notes directory, never in the repo
play   orchestrator         builtin  Work as an orchestrator that delegates to sub-agents
play   plan-review          builtin  Review the workspace plan with reviewer sub-agents, write plan-review.md, and post the verdict to the inbox
play   promote              builtin  Move this checkout's work into a new workspace, seed it, start its agent, and stop working on it here
play   report               builtin  Hand a finished note to the person: post it to the inbox with a link and print the workspace-ui link
play   research             builtin  Research a goal and write the findings to a note in the notes directory, with no code changes
play   review               builtin  Review a diff with reviewer sub-agents and write review.md
play   spine                builtin  Keep this workspace's stages current
spine  default              builtin  Research, plan, implement, verify, review and ship, one file per stage
--- stderr
--- end
